title: Yunpeng Xie
text:
Welcome

My name is Yunpeng Xie, and I am currently a student in the UBC Master of Data Science program. I am interested in data science, quantitative analysis, and the application of artificial intelligence to real-world problems. My previous academic and project experience has included economics, finance, and AI-related research. Through the MDS program, I hope to strengthen my programming, statistical, and computational skills.

title: About
text: I have an academic background that combines math, finance, and data-related analysis. Before joining the UBC Master of Data Science program, I completed graduate-level study and worked on projects involving quantitative analysis and artificial intelligence.

title: About
text:
Why Data Science
I became interested in data science because it connects programming, statistics, and real-world decision-making. I am especially interested in using data and computational tools to understand complex problems in areas such as finance, healthcare, and artificial intelligence.

title: About
text:
Outside of Data Science
Outside of data science, I enjoy traveling, exploring new places, and learning about technology and financial markets. I also like working on projects that combine technical analysis with practical applications.
